transcription_corrections: The main text transcription is correct: 'Aufsätze, Notizen und Rechnungen / zur / Mathematik und Astronomie / gehörig. / Angefangen September 1813.'

The transcription omits a faint blue-violet library stamp in the centre of the page, between 'zur' and 'Mathematik'. This is the Niedersächsische Staats- und Universitätsbibliothek Göttingen ownership stamp; the next-page transcription renders its text ('NIEDERSÄCHS. STAATS- U. UNIV. BIBLIOTHEK GÖTTINGEN').
The transcription omits a pencil archival number '42' in the lower left corner.
The pencil ruling and guide lines under the title lines are not text.
